useWhen: Driving the cloud-itonami-app itonami CLI or its resident server, enumerating its generated commands, or operating the grok-bots / bot-economy / x402 surfaces it owns
avoidWhen: Treating a remembered command name as current (enumerate with `itonami commands`) or editing the itonami.cloud site pages (separate boundary)

compatibilityNote: Hermes skill shape only; home paths in the body are normalized to ~. Wildcard versions express no runtime compatibility.
